title: Standard Adult
subtitle: Paracetamol · 70 kg
story: Alex is a healthy 70 kg adult with a mild headache. Prescribe paracetamol and keep plasma levels in the therapeutic window for as long as possible.
goal: Maximise time in the green zone. Avoid going toxic.

title: Paediatric-weight Patient
subtitle: Ibuprofen · 45 kg
story: Sam is a 45 kg teenager with post-surgical inflammation. Smaller body, smaller volume of distribution — doses must be adjusted carefully.
goal: Stay in the green zone without breaching the toxic threshold.

title: Reduced Liver Function
subtitle: Paracetamol · clearance ×0.6
story: Jordan has mild hepatic impairment. The liver clears paracetamol 40% slower than normal, so standard doses accumulate. Tread carefully.
goal: Keep levels therapeutic despite reduced clearance.

title: Night-shift Caffeine Challenge
subtitle: Caffeine · stay alert, don't crash
story: Morgan is a night-shift nurse who needs to stay alert. Caffeine's long half-life means it lingers — too much and anxiety spikes, too little and performance drops.
goal: Maintain caffeine in the green alertness zone for the whole 24 h shift.

title: Final Challenge
subtitle: Paracetamol · impaired clearance · 55 kg
story: Final test: elderly patient, low body weight and reduced hepatic function. Every decision matters. This is the hardest combination.
goal: Achieve the highest possible time in green. Perfect score requires 80%+ green with 0% red.
